The page numbers above were saved with the file. In Word, right-click the table and choose Update Field (or press F9) to
refresh them. The same applies to the table of figures, the index and the table of authorities.
This list names 139 Word features, grouped by the ribbon tab where you find them, and says where
each sample is. 125 have a sample in this file. The 14 red entries are Word app features that save
nothing in a .docx file, or things that need Word, another program or an add-in to create; they are
listed so the list is complete.
Open this file in Word for Microsoft 365, or Word 2016 or later, to see every sample. Other apps show most of it but not all.
For example, LibreOffice 24.2 shows the tracked changes in section 15.2 as ordinary text, because it drops tracked changes
from any file that has a drop cap.
